column3: core: civicrm_email + dedupe rules match on email; XCM matches API/import contacts

column5: contactEmails gains derived addressNormalized (lowercased, trimmed) + index by_tenant_addressNormalized. Derived from the identity field, so no payload or contract-version change. Loosen/backfill/tighten

column3: core: civicrm_tag + civicrm_entity_tag; tag sets; hierarchical; also tags activities/cases
column4: Product brief MVP: 'tags (member/donor/volunteer)'. Core feature in every Civi install. group2summary 228 / Contact Categories 21 show demand for visible labels
column5: tags table (own aggregate, contract contacts.tag, saveVersion) + contactTags child rows under a new slice contacts.tags (counter tagsVersion). tagId is the identity field. Index by_tenant_tag for segments

column3: core: civicrm_note (subject, body, privacy, attached to any entity)
column4: Product brief MVP: 'notes'. Core feature
column5: contactNotes as its own aggregate (contract contacts.note, saveVersion): one root per note so two staff adding notes never conflict. Erasure scrubs note bodies

column3: core merge: loser trashed (is_deleted=1), 'Contact Deleted by Merge' activity; dedupe exceptions table
column4: Dedupe/merge is core and heavily extended: XCM 1,094, X-Dedupe 117, Deduper 91, Dedupe Monitor 53. CSV imports from spreadsheets make duplicates certain
column5: Decide now, build later: losing contact keeps its row with mergedInto (system field, own contract contacts.merge + mergeVersion). Immutable logs (consent, declarations, revisions) keep the old id and resolve through mergedInto; mutable aggregates are re-pointed by the merge action. Needs an ADR before giving/giftaid/consent are built

column3: Identity Tracker extension: many (type, id) pairs per contact, survives merges
column4: Identity Tracker 705 installs. Imports from spreadsheet + Mailchimp + GoCardless export each bring an id
column5: Replace single externalIdentifier with contactIdentifiers child rows {key, system, value} in the details slice or a new slice; index by_tenant_system_value. Cheapest before any real data exists

column3: core: email_greeting, postal_greeting, addressee (computed + per-contact custom)
column4: More Greetings 134; Fuzion Tokens 1,483 (address block tokens). Thank-you letters and Gift Aid letters need 'Dear Margaret' / 'Mr & Mrs Smith'
column5: ADR 0014 deferred 'computed salutation later'. Computed by default + optional override field in contacts.details (version bump + upcaster). Build with comms
